topStories.headline: Meta's 'Muse' AI Agent Becomes #1 iPhone App, Triggers Massive Chip Stock Rally
topStories.summary: Meta Platforms' new AI agent 'Muse' became the most-downloaded free iPhone app in the US, sparking a wave of investor enthusiasm about agentic AI's voracious demand for semiconductors.
topStories.marketImpact: META ↑ 11%; AMD ↑ 10% (cracks $1T market cap); INTC ↑ 12%; ARM ↑ 17%; QCOM ↑ 9%. S&P 500 ↑ 1.49% to 7,764.70; Nasdaq ↑ 2.26% to 27,122.09 (record close).

topStories.headline: Trump and Xi Begin Historic Washington Summit; Trade Truce Extension and Rare Earths in Focus
topStories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington for a Sept 23–25 state visit — his first US trip in nearly three years — with pre-summit trade talks led by Treasury Secretary Bessent and Vice Premier He Lifeng covering trade, AI, Taiwan, critical minerals, and the Iran war.
topStories.marketImpact: Risk assets globally ↑ on summit optimism; CNY watch for appreciation pressure; rare-earth stocks volatile ahead of Nov 10 export-control expiry. Watch for tariff truce extension communiqué.

topStories.headline: Oil Drops to 11-Day Low as Iran War Diplomacy Gains Momentum at UNGA
topStories.summary: Oil fell for a fourth consecutive session as the UN General Assembly General Debate (beginning Sept 22) raised hopes for diplomatic de-escalation of the US-Iran war; Trump stated he was weighing three options — military destruction, economic strangulation, or a negotiated deal.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent ↓ ~2% to ~$101.67/bbl; WTI ↓ to ~$96–98/bbl, down 9%+ over four sessions. Energy stocks ↓ watch; airline/transport ↑ on lower fuel costs.

topStories.headline: Bank of Japan Raises Rates to 31-Year High of 1.25%; Yen Paradoxically Weakens
topStories.summary: The BOJ raised its policy rate from 1.00% to 1.25% on September 18 in a 7-2 vote — the highest since 1995 — but the yen fell as Governor Ueda offered no forward guidance on further hikes and the 2.75pp gap with the US Fed keeps the carry trade attractive.
topStories.marketImpact: USD/JPY ↑ toward ¥156–158 (yen weakens); Nikkei closed for Silver Week (65,018.95 reference); JGB yields ↑ watch; Japanese exporters mixed. Markets reopen Sept 24.

topStories.headline: Trump Announces US-Denmark Greenland Security Deal; Mining Stocks Surge 100–245%
topStories.summary: The US, Denmark, and Greenland reached an agreement granting the US an expanded military footprint in Greenland without a sovereignty transfer, triggering a frenzy in US-listed Arctic resource stocks.
topStories.marketImpact: GRML ↑ 245%; GLND ↑ 159%; CRML ↑ 37%. Critical metals and Arctic resource names broadly ↑ on strategic backing.

topStories.headline: China Annual Trade Surplus Nears $806B Record Driven by AI Export Boom
topStories.summary: China's August exports jumped 25% year-on-year to $401.44B with semiconductor exports nearly doubling and high-tech products up 40.7%, fueled by the global AI infrastructure buildout; the surplus with the US hit $29B for the month, its widest since Trump returned to office.
topStories.marketImpact: CNY watch for US appreciation pressure; Chinese tech/semis ↑ on export strength. US tariff escalation risk if summit produces no truce deal.

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Gains 0.5% as Tech and Health-Tech Shares Rally Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
topStories.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index climbed 121 points to ~24,872 on Monday, led by technology and health-tech stocks, as investors positioned ahead of the Trump-Xi Washington summit and AI sector momentum spread from the US rally.
topStories.marketImpact: 0700.HK, 9988.HK broadly ↑; Shanghai Composite ↑ 0.55% to 3,933.37. Watch for summit outcome as key near-term catalyst.

topStories.headline: UNGA General Debate Opens in New York with Iran, AI, and Climate on the Agenda
topStories.summary: The UN General Assembly's 81st-session General Debate kicks off today with ~130 world leaders speaking; the US-Iran war, artificial intelligence governance, and climate change top the agenda as global multilateralism faces growing strain.
topStories.marketImpact: Oil prices watch for Iran diplomacy signals ↓; watch for any joint statement or ceasefire framework impacting energy markets.

companiesToWatch.name: Meta Platforms
companiesToWatch.reason: Muse AI agent becoming the #1 downloaded free iPhone app signals mainstream agentic AI adoption and cements Meta as the near-term catalyst for the AI supercycle narrative.

companiesToWatch.name: Advanced Micro Devices
companiesToWatch.reason: Crossed $1 trillion market cap for the first time on Monday as agentic AI inference demand drives bullish expectations for AMD's CPU and GPU roadmap.

companiesToWatch.name: Intel
companiesToWatch.reason: Surged 12% on a combination of Meta Muse CPU demand and new AI chip packaging news with AUO; sentiment reversing sharply after prolonged underperformance.

companiesToWatch.name: Arm Holdings
companiesToWatch.reason: Rallied 17% as AI agents require significant CPU inference capacity, boosting demand for Arm-architecture chips that power most mobile and edge devices.

companiesToWatch.name: Greenland Mines
companiesToWatch.reason: Surged 245% on the US-Denmark Greenland security agreement, which gives US-aligned resource companies strategic backing for Arctic mineral development.
